entities.name: Tarem
entities.description: A Dimir agent and notion thief on Ravnica who can steal thoughts and memories, and who appears not to age.

entities.name: Oana
entities.description: A young defender who became an Azorius defender, arbiter, judge and adjudicator after making a deal with Tarem.

entities.name: Otho Vitellius the II
entities.description: Oana's deceased grandfather, whose memories Tarem offered her.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: The guild Tarem serves as an agent.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The guild in which Oana built her legal career.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: A guild whose holding a Dimir agent broke into.

events.summary: Tarem approaches Oana at a bar and offers her the memories of her dead grandfather in exchange for a later service to the Dimir.
events.quote: He approached her and offered her the opportunity to gain the memories of her deceased grandfather Otho Vitellius the II

events.summary: Oana agrees, but Tarem alters her memory so she recalls refusing, and she builds a guilt-free career as an Azorius defender and judge.
events.quote: Tarem altered her memories so that she would remember denying him

events.summary: Thirty years later Tarem waits at Oana's home and reveals the truth of the deal, proving it with a memory of her at seven.
events.quote: Tarem then revealed to Oana the truth - that she had accepted his deal and that she had no memory of this fact.

events.summary: Tarem asks Oana to falsify a judgment to free a Dimir agent; she refuses, breaking the deal, and flees.
events.quote: Oana refused Tarem however, breaking their deal, and fled.

relations.quote: Tarem is a Dimir agent on the plane of Ravnica .
her deceased grandfather Otho Vitellius the II
she built a guilt-free successful career as an Azorius defender
